question:
(a) Explain why eddy currents are produced in a metallic block placed in a changing magnetic field.
(b) State one method used to reduce eddy currents and justify it.

options.A:
A changing magnetic flux induces circulating currents in the metallic block, called eddy currents.
Using insulated laminated sheets increases the resistance of current paths and reduces eddy currents.
options.B:
A steady magnetic field induces eddy currents in the metal.
Using a solid metal block reduces the resistance and hence reduces eddy currents.
options.C:
Eddy currents are produced because the metal is permanently magnetised.
Increasing the thickness of the solid block reduces the eddy currents.
options.D:
Eddy currents are produced only by electric fields.
Using highly conductive sheets reduces the current paths and eliminates them.
